python3 << 'PY'
import os, re, subprocess
from collections import defaultdict

root = "/bench/repo"
internal = os.path.join(root, "internal")

# Collect all exported and unexported func/method symbols in internal/
# Pattern: func (recv) Name( or func Name(
func_decl = re.compile(r'^func (?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(')

symbols = {}  # name -> list of (path, is_method, recv_type approx)

for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(internal):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.go') or f.endswith('_test.go'):
            continue
        path = os.path.join(dirpath, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(path, root)
        pkg = None
        with open(path) as fh:
            content = fh.read()
            for line in content.splitlines():
                m = re.match(r'^package (\w+)', line)
                if m:
                    pkg = m.group(1)
                    break
        if not pkg:
            continue
        with open(path) as fh:
            for i, line in enumerate(fh, 1):
                line = line.strip()
                if not line.startswith('func '):
                    continue
                # method
                mm = re.match(r'^func \(([^)]+)\)\s+(\w+)\s*\(', line)
                if mm:
                    recv = mm.group(1).strip()
                    name = mm.group(2)
                    # simplify recv type
                    recv_type = recv.split()[-1].lstrip('*')
                    key = f"({recv_type}).{name}"
                    symbols.setdefault(key, []).append((rel, i, pkg, name))
                else:
                    mf = re.match(r'^func (\w+)\s*\(', line)
                    if mf:
                        name = mf.group(1)
                        key = f"{pkg}.{name}" if name[0].isupper() else name
                        symbols.setdefault(key, []).append((rel, i, pkg, name))

print(f"Total symbol keys: {len(symbols)}")
# show sample
for k in list(symbols.keys())[:5]:
    print(k, symbols[k][0])
PY

while IFS= read -r path; do

  grep -n "^func " "$path" 2>/dev/null | while IFS=: read -r linenum rest; do
    name=$(echo "$rest" | sed -n 's/^func (\([^)]*\)) \+\([^(]*\)(.*/\2/p; s/^func \+\([^(]*\)(.*/\1/p')

        cnt=$(grep -rn "\b${name}\s*(" /bench/repo/internal --include="*.go" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | grep -v ":func " | wc -l)
        # subtract method receiver calls counted differently
        echo "$cnt $name — $rel:$linenum"
